children: Leading consumer technology retailer to improve product availability, inventory visibility, and planning automation across stores and distribution centers

, a leading retailer of consumer technology, has selected RELEX to optimize forecasting and replenishment across its retail network. With RELEX, Best Buy Canada will improve inventory visibility, automate planning processes, and support omnichannel operations across stores and distribution centers.

Headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia, Best Buy Canada operates more than 300 stores supported by two distribution centers and manages approximately 2.1 million SKUs. The retailer serves millions of customers throughout the country, making inventory visibility and planning efficiency critical to its operations.

Best Buy Canada was looking for a solution to improve alignment between inventory and customer demand that would support driving greater efficiency across its growing network. RELEX's ability to incorporate supply chain constraints into replenishment planning, optimize inventory across channels, support large-scale retail operations, and automate key planning processes aligned closely with Best Buy Canada's goals.

"Accurate planning is essential to meeting customer expectations in a competitive consumer electronics market," said Christian Trudel, VP Inventory & Merchandising Operations at Best Buy Canada. "RELEX gives us the tools to improve planning efficiency that supports delivering a better experience for our customers across Canada."

"As retail operations become increasingly connected across stores, distribution centers, and digital channels, planning teams need tools that help them respond quickly and confidently," said Greg Westrick, Vice President at RELEX Solutions. "The ability to automate routine planning activities while maintaining visibility across the network can have a meaningful impact on both operational efficiency and customer experience. We're proud to support Best Buy Canada as they continue building a stronger foundation for planning and execution."

RELEX Solutions provides an AI platform for intelligent decision-making and automation across complex operational environments. Trusted by 600+ customers globally, RELEX helps retailers, manufacturers, and wholesalers plan, decide, and act across demand, inventory, merchandising, pricing, and supply chain operations.

Built on two decades of domain expertise and a unified data foundation, the RELEX platform helps companies to deploy, connect, and scale capabilities on a single platform, to innovate at their own pace. Leading brands like ADUSA, Camco, Carhartt, COSMOS Pharmaceutical Corporation, Circle K, Dollar Tree and Family Dollar, M&S Food, PetSmart, Rituals, The Body Shop, The Home Depot, Sun Tire & Auto Service, and Vita Coco use RELEX to run and continuously evolve their operations.
